summary: Two climbers stranded on The Loft, Longs Peak, during the September 2013 Front Range flood; park rangers attempted a rescue Thursday but severe weather blocked ground and helicopter access; the pair self-evacuated Friday morning uninjured, then rangers evacuated them across washed-out bridges and trails by ATV.
notes: September 2013 Front Range flood; stranded Thursday morning 2013-09-12, self-evacuated Friday 2013-09-13.
